LESSON: WRITING 6.5.1 CREATIVE WRITING

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.5: Writing 6.5.1 Creative Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 6.5.1 Creative Writing, part of Strand 6 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: Why should we be coherent and logical in our writing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 6.5.1 Creative Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: The learner works as a group to plan to write a narrative and a descriptive composition.

Values:
Responsibility: The learner’s diligence is strengthened as they carry out online research on the descriptive narrative samples.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Socio-economic issues- safety and security: The learner’s safety is upheld as they search online and offline for samples of

descriptive narrative essays and verbs derived from other word classes.

Suggested Learning Resources

● Print texts

● Braille texts

● Electronic reading materials

● Digital devices with assistive technology

● Audio visual clips

Suggested Skills:

● Writing narrative and descriptive essays on given topics.
